newsitem.title: CANADA: Gaz Met CEO may become Hydro-Quebec CEO.
newsitem.headline: Gaz Met CEO may become Hydro-Quebec CEO.

text.p: Quebec gas utility Gaz Metropolitain and Co LP said its president and chief executive officer, Andre Caille, had been approached about becoming president and chief executive of provincially owned electricity utility Hydro-Quebec.

The Quebec government said on Wednesday it named Jean-Andre Elie interim chairman of Hydro-Quebec, following the forced resignation on Tuesday night of Yvon Martineau, chairman since March 22, 1995. Martineau's departure was widely expected because of executive infighting and a power struggle involving provincial Energy Minister Guy Chevrette.
President and chief executive Benoit Michel quit in July over disagreements with Martineau.
